container_shape.description: Every pointer/item list in this routine follows one shape: an 8-slot inline segment reached through a pointer field, a heap segment with begin/end pointer fields, and an inline-count field. The element loop runs heap_count + inline_count times; element i comes from the inline segment when i <= 7 and from the heap segment at index i - 8 otherwise. The binary's element-selection threshold is the fixed constant 8, so the model treats well-formed inputs as inline_count == 8; inputs with a different inline_count are outside the pinned behavior.
